chapter_summary: Short chapter on outside bars: how to define them, why breakouts of them are usually bad entries (they are one-bar trading ranges), and the exceptions (outside bar as an entry bar after a good signal bar, with-trend outside bars in the first leg of a reversal, ioi patterns, fades of small bars near an outside bar's extremes, failed breakouts of outside bars). Produced the OutsideBar / ioi / oo pattern family, several context filters (middle-of-range, large bar, strong-trend-only-with-trend, majority-bodies), the moving-average gap bar, and a few hard swing/leg-based setups. Primitives (OutsideBar, BullTrendBar, BullReversalBar, SmallBar, InsideBar, Ema20, TradingRangeContext, StrongTrendContext) are redefined here per the one-per-file rule and duplicate chapter 6's.
